decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered PL/VP/2148/BM/01, PL/VP/2148/BM/02, PL/VP/2148/BM/03, PL/VP/2148/BM/04 rev A, PL/VP/2148/BM/05, PL/VP/2148/BM/06, PL/VP/2148/BM/07 rev A, PL/VP/2148/BM/08 received 08/03/2012 therewith approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house.
